_: What the assistant (and scan.py, which needs no model) reads before it scans, judges or applies for jobs. Copy to profile.json and edit; profile.json is in .gitignore.

boards._: public job boards scan.py reads; the slug is the last part of boards.greenhouse.io/<slug>, jobs.lever.co/<slug>, jobs.ashbyhq.com/<slug>

signals._: literal phrases scan.py looks for in a posting's text; the lists under quality are for the assistant's judgement

quality.scale: 1-5: 1 generic ad, 3 real team and stack named, 5 stack matches skills and seniority fits
weak: 3+ years asked at a junior title

cv.style: plain, short bullets, a number or link under every claim
avoid: claims without a link or number

cover_letter.tone: direct, specific to the posting, no flattery

apply_only_if: score >= quality.min_score and no deal_breaker matches; otherwise add it to applications.json as stage 'watching' with a one-line reason
